answer: Before any benefit, the cost: every receipt is commit-reveal, so an answer is hashed first and opened later, and a failed audit costs the stake behind it. Duplicates are caught by replay, not by name, which means renaming an account changes nothing. An operator pays once per failed audit and pays again on every clone that copies the same text. The ivory of a clean record takes epochs to build, a glacier moves faster than a farm rebuilds after a slash, and a falcon of an auditor is enough to spot the replay.
